Candidate: Linus Torvalds
Round: Code Review

Feedback: Very abrasive during the pairing session. He got visibly frustrated when asked to use modern web tooling and insisted on writing everything in C. He's obviously a genius (created Linux and Git) but might not be a culture fit for our collaborative frontend team.

I tried emailing him at torvalds@linux-foundation.org and linus@linux.org to follow up but he was pretty dismissive.
Recommendation: Strong No Hire due to behavioral.
